doc_release.title: ZM3D release calendar — Q4
doc_release.text:
Zombie Match 3D store submissions, Q4 2025. Owner: Arthur.
Oct 17 submission: the last build that can carry Halloween changes. Merge cut is Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT. Anything that ships in the build has to be merged by then. Submit Fri Oct 17.
iOS screenshots can only change with a new version, so new iOS screenshots go up with the Oct 17 submission and are due by the same Oct 16 12:00 PT cut.
Apple review has been taking up to 3 days, so plan on that build and its iOS store listing being live from Wed Oct 22.
Google Play listing graphics are not tied to a build: upload any day and allow 1 day for review.
Nov 6 submission: post-Halloween clean-up (icon and screenshots back to normal).

deck_seasonal.title: Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025
slides:
Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025
Halloween and the holidays, store and ads

Before any seasonal pass
Seasonal dressing goes on top of the current art only. Anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the zombie swap with the new background, Jul 29) is redone on the current build first. If a later capture has replaced it, the newest capture is the one that counts.
A video whose master has the music baked in is re-exported from the project first, so the seasonal cut can be re-edited.

What changes
Only the seasonal layer changes: pumpkins, fog, props, the title treatment. Same flat background, same pose, same zombie order, same CTA, so a seasonal variant still tests clean against its normal version.

Calls for the tracker
Halloween version: dress it from the current art.
Refresh first: re-capture or re-export before any seasonal pass.
Reuse: it already has a seasonal version, use that one.
Skip: no seasonal version this time.
